title: device.telemetry.received v1
description: Emitted when a device reports telemetry data through any ingestion protocol (MQTT, HTTP, CoAP). The event carries the raw telemetry values and the protocol context. This schema validates only the payload; the full event must also satisfy envelope.schema.json.

device_id.description: Stable device identifier within the tenant scope. Combined with tenant_id, uniquely identifies a device.

product_key.description: Identifier of the product (device model). Used to look up the thing model and validate metric names.

protocol.description: Ingestion protocol used by the device. Known values include mqtt, http, coap, and websocket, but this field is intentionally open for future adapters such as modbus, opcua, or lora.

metrics.description: Map of metric name to value. Metric names should match the product's thing model. Values can be number, boolean, or string depending on the metric type.

raw.description: Optional metadata captured by the ingestion layer, such as the original source, raw payload size, or protocol-specific headers. Consumers should not depend on specific fields here.
